query:
INSERT INTO seller_profile_research_cache_entries (
            profile_id,
            research_run_id,
            cache_type,
            cache_key,
            payload,
            http_status,
            expires_at
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            ($3::text)::seller_profile_research_cache_type,
            $4,
            $5::jsonb,
            $6,
            now() + interval '7 days'
         )
         ON CONFLICT (research_run_id, cache_type, cache_key) DO UPDATE
         SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload,
             http_status = EXCLUDED.http_status,
             fetched_at = now(),
             expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
